# Synchronization
The client queues a change, uploads it, receives an acknowledgement, then removes the queue item.
```mermaid
flowchart LR
 A[Edit]-->B[Queue]-->C[Upload]-->D[Acknowledge]-->E[Remove]
 C-->F[Retry]-->C
```
| Field | Meaning |
| revision | Server version |
| pending | Local queue size |
For a first sync, press Connect and wait for pending to become zero.
